stem:
Triangle \(DEF\) and triangle \(GHI\) are similar right triangles.

Based on this information, which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The relationship between the slope of the hypotenuse of triangle \(DEF\) and the slope of the hypotenuse of triangle \(GHI\) cannot be determined.

options.label: B
options.text: The slope of the hypotenuse of triangle \(DEF\) is greater than the slope of the hypotenuse of triangle \(GHI\).

options.label: C
options.text: The slope of the hypotenuse of triangle \(DEF\) is less than the slope of the hypotenuse of triangle \(GHI\).

options.label: D
options.text: The slope of the hypotenuse of triangle \(DEF\) is equal to the slope of the hypotenuse of triangle \(GHI\).

visual_elements: Graph with points D(-7,6), E(-4,6), F(-7,3), G(-3,2), H(5,2), I(5,-4) plotted, triangles DEF and GHI indicated as similar right triangles
